# Acme Analytics — Executive Dossier

Acme Analytics is a fictional data analytics company created solely for
this offline, synthetic demo. It builds batch and streaming data products
for mid-market retailers and employs roughly 120 people.

The company runs its platform on Python, SQL, Spark and Airflow, and
packages services with Docker. Leadership emphasises reliable data
pipelines, clear ownership and measurable delivery.

Выручка компании растёт за счёт облачных аналитических сервисов.
